summary: BXPE U.S. and its feeder (TE) filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 covering Item 1.01 (material definitive agreement) and Item 5.03 (amendments to organizational documents). The Funds disclosed an intention to offer and sell new series of limited partnership units in a continuous private placement exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D to accredited investors who are also qualified purchasers. Existing Class S, D and N units were redesignated as Series I, and new Series IV and Series E units were designated. No price, stake, premium or closing date was stated; the event is a routine series designation for an ongoing private fund offering, not a special situation.
